author: Goode, 1880

note.en: An 18 cm whiff of the outer shelf (46 to 366 m) whose known range is the US Atlantic coast and the Gulf of Mexico; Bussing & López list it for Costa Rica's Caribbean, a record that needs confirmation.
note.es: Un lenguado de 18 cm de la plataforma externa (46 a 366 m) cuya área conocida es la costa atlántica de EE. UU. y el golfo de México; Bussing y López lo incluyen para el Caribe de Costa Rica, un registro que hay que confirmar.

evidence: Added: not in the original species list
Listed for Costa Rica's Caribbean coast by Bussing & López (2010), whose guide is based on University of Costa Rica museum specimens
No iNaturalist, OBIS or GBIF records from Costa Rica or Panama

sources.t: Bussing & López 2010, Peces costeros del Caribe de Centroamérica meridional, Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2): 190-193 (Paralichthyidae)
